item.title: NSA Ajit Doval holds 25th India-China border talks with Wang Yi
item.summary: In a significant diplomatic encounter, National Security Adviser Ajit Doval engaged with Chinese Vice President Han Zheng in Beijing. Their discussions centered on boundary issues to ensure peace, while also enhancing economic and political ties. The leaders are committed to managing differences and promoting long-term bilateral cooperation, following a series of recent high-level discussions between Modi and Xi.
